vb_textbox.text: I received an advice, I tested and tried it and it helped me so I will tell you same. To earn plenty of points, select the gnomes with brighter colors as well as purple. When you select those gnomes, they help you get more mushrooms and more mushrooms equals more points. Choosing gnomes with dull colors as well as pink will usually result in fewer mushrooms, hence fewer points. For every mushroom you collect, you earn a point and it increases your chance of obtaining higher rewards so try your best to earn more. However sometimes, choosing the brighter plus purple may not give you many mushrooms, which happens fewer times but when they do try to switch to the darker colors as well as pink to earn more mushrooms.
